# Maxie Family Hair Salon

> Family hair salon based in Hutto, Texas. Quick, friendly cuts for moms, dads, boys and girls, plus bright color work, with honest advice and great pricing right on FM 1660.

- Phone: (512) 846-1866
- Based in: Hutto, TX
- Nearby areas: Hutto, Round Rock, Pflugerville, Taylor, Georgetown
- Google rating: 4.6 from 200 reviews

## Services
- Family haircuts: Kids' cuts (12 and under) $20, men's $25, women's $35, seniors from $20.
- Restyles & bobs: Long hair to an A-line bob, or a cut that finally works with thick, curly hair.
- Color & highlights: All-over color from $100, full highlights from $250, partial highlights from $180.
- Balayage & fashion color: Full balayage from $250, partial balayage $200, plus blue, hot pink and other bright shades.
- Blowouts, perms & waxing: Brazilian blowouts, perms, deep conditioning, event up-dos and brow wax.
- Salon hair care: Take the salon home: shampoos, conditioners and styling products on our shelves.

## About
We're in the limestone strip center at 550 S FM 1660 in Hutto, the one with the Texas star on the front. Inside: a deep purple wall with our name in white script, dusty blue-gray walls, black chairs and shelves of salon hair care. It's a family salon in the truest sense. Parents bring all their kids, boys and girls, and some clients have been coming for more than seven years. Reviewers call Maxi and her team honest, friendly and quick, and keep mentioning the great prices. We do the everyday cuts and the big changes: long hair to an A-line bob, cuts for thick, curly hair, silver highlights for clients growing out their gray, and copper, blue and hot pink color. Appointments are preferred, but walk-ins and new clients are always welcome.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday to Friday 10 AM to 7 PM, Saturday 9 AM to 5 PM, Sunday 10 AM to 2:30 PM. Closed Monday.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 550 S FM 1660, Suite 6, Hutto, TX 78634, in the limestone strip center with the Texas star on the front.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes. Appointments are preferred, but walk-ins and new clients are always welcome. Call (512) 846-1866 to check the wait.
- Q: How much is a haircut?
  A: Kids' cuts (12 and under) are $20, men's $25, women's $35 and seniors from $20. Color, balayage and treatments vary with length and thickness; consultations are free.
- Q: Do you cut kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Families bring all their kids here, boys and girls, and parents say it's a truly family-friendly place.
- Q: Do you do color and highlights?
  A: Yes: all-over color, full and partial highlights, balayage, money pieces, root touch-ups and bright fashion shades like blue, copper and hot pink.
